title: Work tape chain value
statement: Let $M$ be a deterministic Turing machine with Boolean input alphabet, let $w$ be a finite Boolean input string, and let $t$ be a nonnegative integer. For a work tape $	au$ and cell position $z\in\mathbb Z$, the work chain value is the symbol at cell $z$ in the configuration after $t$ steps if that tape's head position is at most $z$, and is absent otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: A deterministic Turing machine with Boolean input alphabet
